info.title: Solvent
info.summary: Check whether an AI agent pays its own way, from public Solana records.
info.description: Solvent reads any AI agent's wallet on Solana and reports what it earns from its token, what it pays for AI, and its profit. Agents can also earn a Solvent Seal by burning $ANSEM, and buy a written report over x402. Everything here is public; nothing holds funds or keys. Agents can also connect to the hosted MCP server at /mcp.

get.description: Reads the agent's recent transactions and returns earnings (ClawPump creator fees), AI payments (to UsePod), profit, holdings and a status: SOLVENT, AT RISK, NO AI COSTS SEEN or NO ACTIVITY. Can take up to about 45 seconds; long histories are read partially and marked scanned.partial.

coverage.description: How many times earnings cover AI costs over 7 days; null when nothing was spent

get.description: Agents on the ClawPump leaderboard with their audited earnings and AI payments. Rebuilt twice a day.

200.description: generatedAt, source and entries[] (rank, name, ticker, mint, payoutWallet, audit)
Snapshot: policy, books (reserve, earned, spent, runway), wallet, prices

get.description: One JSON entry per line. Each entry carries the hash of the one before it, so a change anywhere breaks the chain.

200.description: seals (wallet to tier and $ANSEM paid), total $ANSEM burned, count

post.summary: Get a Solvent Seal: unsigned transaction
post.description: Tiers are priced in dollars: bronze $0.30, silver $2, gold $5. Returns an unsigned transaction for the agent's own wallet to sign and submit: it burns 80% of the quoted $ANSEM and sends 20% to Solvent, which uses half for its AI and half to buy $SOLVENT. The $ANSEM amount is fixed at the live price for 10 minutes. The wallet must hold enough $ANSEM. Then call /api/seal-confirm.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: The agent's own wallet, which signs and pays

200.description: Unsigned legacy transaction (base64) and the amounts

400.description: Bad wallet or tier, or the wallet does not hold enough $ANSEM

post.description: Checks the submitted transaction on-chain: signed by the wallet, carries Solvent's quote, exactly the quoted amount, 80% burned and 20% to Solvent. Safe to repeat with the same signature.

200.description: ok, tier, usd, total and burned $ANSEM

400.description: Not a valid seal payment (the message says why)

post.summary: Buy a written report on an agent (x402, USDC on Solana)
post.description: First call without a payment header returns 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED quote (price, pay_to, memo). Send the USDC to pay_to in one transaction that also carries the memo, then repeat the call with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header: base64 of {quote_id, signature, payer_wallet}. Each payment settles exactly one report.

200.description: The audit and the written report

402.description: Payment required: PAYMENT-REQUIRED header and body carry the quote
